summary.text: Carolyn Comitta represents the 19th District in the Pennsylvania Senate, a seat she has held since 2020.
Her official biography lists earlier service as a state representative for the 156th Legislative District, mayor of West Chester and a West Chester borough councilwoman.

paragraphs.text: Comitta earned a bachelor of science in education from West Chester State College in 1974 and a master of science in education from Widener University in 1989.

She was a teacher and curriculum specialist in the Octorara Area School District from 1974 to 1985 and has been vice president of Thomas Comitta Associates, a town planning and landscape architecture firm in West Chester, since 1990.
She served on West Chester's borough council from 2006 to 2010 and as mayor from 2010 to 2016.
She was state representative for the 156th Legislative District from 2016 to 2020, and her biography lists her service as state senator for the 19th District as 2020 to present.

She was a West Chester University Political Science Department legislative fellow in 2019-2020, and she has served on the leadership training council of the National League of Cities and on the board of the Pennsylvania Municipal League.
